question_text: Will the yield of 10-year U.S. treasury notes be below 3.95 on Nov 13, 2025?
resolution_criteria:
If the yield curve par rate for 10-year U.S. treasury notes is below 3.95 % on Nov 13, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market will expire at the sooner of the first 7:00 PM ET following the data release for Nov 13, 2025, or one week following Nov 13, 2025.
